d:
And here we are, the start of a new series! Chapter 1 of Ruriko's adventure!

Ruriko has become my favorite Ozaki character and it's not even close! I really love how she let's herself be her true self more and more during these volume.

This is going to be a very fun manga to work on because of that, I'm really excited!

Thank you as always for the kind words and happy reading!
